provenance.writtenFor: Ultimate Master Pump synthetic evaluation breadth batch 2 (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A workload grants SYS_ADMIN, which is close to host-level control.

groundTruth.rationale: SYS_ADMIN enables mount and namespace operations that commonly escape to the host; the capability should not be granted to application pods.

limitations: Matches the capability name on the line; the regex match ends at the identifier, and equivalent privilege grants through other fields are not evaluated.
